[JustinGuitar](https://www.justinguitar.com) is an online guitar school by Justin Sandercoe. This page lists its Beginner Course and its Practical Music Theory lessons in order. Each step links to the lesson at justinguitar.com, says in a line what the title promises, and points to the pages and tools on this site that cover the same ground (tuning, chord shapes, picking, scales, chord analysis and more). The lessons themselves are not copied: open each at his site. The songs he teaches are in the [Tune Directory](../practice/tune-directory.qmd).

The one-line summaries are written from the lesson titles, because his site did not let the page text be read; they say what a title suggests, not what the lesson contains.
